id.description: Present on the materialised object. MUST be absent from the create Event payload: zh/models/common-fields.md derives it from the create Event's own event_id (retyped), so a payload-supplied id would be a second, forgeable truth.

scope_circle_id.description: Optional intra-Realm Circle (models/circle.md) defining this Relation fact's effective scope, supplied in the submit payload. For confidential_discussion_of it points to the private Strand's Circle. For structural relations the resulting effective_scope MUST NOT be wider than the narrowest participating endpoint scope (circle.md §6.1). Sidecar context mappings are native sidecar.context cells, not Relation objects.

effective_scope.description: Read-only immutable effective scope of this Relation fact, materialized from the accepted Event.scope_ref after the receiver verifies it against scope_circle_id and endpoint pre-state (circle.md §6.1-§6.2). For structural relations it MUST NOT be wider than the narrowest participating endpoint scope. It remains immutable across any later scope rebind and MUST NOT appear in actor-supplied content payload (reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed).

relation_kind.description: Relation semantic. The standard kind vocabulary (kind list, cardinality class, truth-source class, weak_semantic flag) is machine-indexed in artifacts/registry/relation-kind-registry.json; detailed dedupe/scope/conflict semantics in models/relation.md §3-§6. Cross-Realm constraint: structural relations 'contains' and 'belongs_to' MUST NOT cross Realm (resolved from_ref and to_ref MUST share the same realm_id); weak_semantic=true kinds per the registry MAY cross Realm subject to two-sided authorization. Stays a free string so extension profiles can add kinds; unregistered kinds are opaque edges (unknown_relation_kind), never container/visibility semantics.

rank.description: Top-level rank string for ordered relations (e.g. contains-list-strand position). Encoding follows conformance/encoding.md §9. Aligned with Space.rank so all rank-bearing canonical objects expose rank at the top level instead of fields.rank.

fields.description: Edge metadata. MUST NOT contain a 'rank' key — rank moved to the top level in v1 to align with Space.rank.

state.description: Relation state. 'tombstoned' covers both deletion and redaction; the originating reason is preserved on the ak.relation.tombstone / ak.redaction event, not on the materialized object.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding ak.relation.tombstone / redaction Event. Aligns with Space.state_changed_at and the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

object_ref.description: Typed canonical reference. Allowed kinds: realm, space, actor_profile, strand, message, morph, relation, event, view, blob metadata ID, content-addressed blob ref (active digest suites per artifacts/registry/digest-suite-registry.json; v1: sha256 / blake3), or DID. Space is a valid Relation endpoint (board/list containers, e.g. board --contains--> list). The blob ref suite set is aligned with blob.schema.json and notification.schema.json so any content-addressed blob ref accepted in those schemas is also accepted as a Relation endpoint.

relation_conflict_diagnostic.description: Projection-only require_review diagnostic containing the complete bounded concurrent head set. reducer_input MUST be false; MUST NOT be treated as canonical event bytes, a winner, or dedupe authority. See zh/models/relation.md §6.

dedupe_key.description: Canonical projection of the dedupe key under which these candidates collided.

heads.description: Complete canonical concurrent head set, sorted by event_id for wire stability only. No member is a winner or loser.

event_digest.description: Canonical signed Event digest (<digest-suite>:<hex>), retained as evidence and used only for stable presentation order; it does not select a winner.

reason.description: Optional reason code for this candidate's disposition (e.g. relation_conflict_fanout_exceeded).
